_boxNote: Mixed-item box consolidation (standard-box.ts): a DIVERSE huge order (many different small items, none identical enough to group) gets its loose small units binned single-layer onto shared standard boxes (mixed pallets), so each box is one placeable object holding many real units — otherwise the diverse units blow maxPackableBlocks. footprintM defaults to a full UK pallet for maximum reduction; set it smaller (e.g. 0.6 x 0.5, a quarter-pallet carton) for finer boxes. maxHeightM bounds what counts as a 'small' boxable item. Boxes stack per the normal crush validator; fragile items box separately and advertise a zero top load.
